identification: Two clear pressed-glass kerosene table lamps with glass chimneys and brass/metal burners, one with octagonal font and base, the other with round font and ribbed round base; plus a box of Aladdin No.14 wick (modern, made in England). Mid 20th century style, common.

entries.note: c.1900s Bismarck reading lamp, a better quality named type, not like these plain pressed glass lamps

searches_tried: | chrome: Terapeak EBAY-AU 'glass oil lamp' and 'antique kerosene lamp glass', 3yr SOLD. Clearly under A$100.
viewing_check: Look for chips or cracks in fonts and chimneys, and any moulded maker name on the base.
